tickets.text: The ticket buys the break of pivot_high 456.5, a breakout entry. With D swing_class LH/LL my set-up is a retracement hook, and bar_range_history is NOT_SERVED so I cannot classify a contraction breakout (R1, C12). I would clear on h1_close_above:bar_high, the hourly hook out of the pullback.

A D close over high_52w_close is a chase of the extreme: dist_to_20bar_high_pct 3.32, day_vol 0.85. The tight pause is range contraction I cannot see (bar_range_history NOT_SERVED) and no retracement is named. I would clear on in_zone:ma_20 then a close over the prior high (R1, C3).

ADVANCE on h1_close_above:bar_high is a close at the extreme, dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.15, no higher low formed: the breakout close Turtle Soup Plus One fades (C3). No set-up type fits (R1). I would clear on WATCH until a pullback holds ma_20 and hooks over the prior high.

An add on a held name after run_10d 24.76 buys a range-expansion run at the extreme with no retracement. C19 says lock the windfall in, not add to it. I would clear on an add only after a first pullback holds ma_20 and hooks, with the R7 windfall-protection flag shown on the ticket.

Raschke supports the hook: h1_close_above:bar_high once H1 ema_order is back to 9>21. Reservation: horizon_sessions 20 is long for a short-swing method (C18), and the ma_50 41.98 wrong-if is far from a one-or-two-tick swing stop (C17); name the swing-low stop.
